policy: All four original Kokoro voices, a fixed Nyx WAV and a zero cue at each of the 18 original command clocks. Place active 20 ms frames ending at the command, using the original -30 dB power rule and matching all cue levels with 1 dB of peak headroom. Retain every sample before the common 1.10 s slot and from the command onwards. Same dry direct channel.
